Mother wins barefoot race in saree, earns prize money

A 47-year-old mother, identified as a participant in a race, won prize money after running barefoot and wearing a saree. She reportedly outran trained runners. The prize money was intended to help pay for her daughter's school fees. The race involved a prize of 3,000 rupees.
